responsibility: This definition module is the master token enumeration for mc’s lexer and parser passes. It defines the toktype values for punctuation, Modula-2 keywords, GNU extensions, literals, directives, and comment tokens, supplying the shared lexical vocabulary consumed by mcflex, mcLexBuf, and all generated mcp* parsers.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the canonical Modula-2 declaration of the shared toktype enumeration for the mcReserved stem; unlike mcReserved.h it exposes the tokens to Modula-2 modules, and unlike mcReserved.mod it carries the actual token list rather than being empty.
